_comment: Map each DOT to a body role. ids: 6-hex address suffix (stable MAC on Linux/Pi; rotates on macOS) and/or on-device tag. Run `python identify.py` to list. elevation axes match x-up vertical strapping on both segments; after pressing Calibrate in the UI these are replaced by pose-derived axes anyway.

trigger._comment: TTL OUTPUT ONLY - nothing here decides a stimulation. What decides is the model: threshold on p_smooth in config.json, spaced by its stim_ms/lockout_ms. refractory_s is a hardware-side ceiling on top of that, independent of the model; 0.0 means the model's own spacing is the only limit.
